title: A pilot study of tenofovir alafenamide fumarate as a promising therapeutic candidate for feline leukemia virus infection.
authors: Weihui Li; Quanhui Yan; Jiajia Peng; Luying Li; Yan Zhang; Zijun Ye; Junyao Xiong; Qiuyan Li; Youhui Si; Shengbo Cao
english_summary: This study found that a drug called tenofovir alafenamide fumarate (TAF) effectively reduced viral levels and shedding in cats infected with the feline leukemia virus in a laboratory setting.
mandarin_summary: 研究发现，替诺福韦艾拉酚胺（TAF）能有效降低实验室猫感染猫白血病病毒后的病毒载量和排毒量。
english_insight: This study is early research, so please ask your vet if this new treatment option might be relevant for your cat's health in the future.
mandarin_insight: 这是一项初步研究，请咨询您的兽医，了解未来是否有相关的治疗方案可供您的猫咪使用。

title: High-titer convalescent serum from cats recovered from severe fever with thrombocytopenia syndrome protects SFTSV-infected mice.
authors: Hirohisa Mekata; Mari Yamamoto; Takeshi Kawaguchi; Tamaki Okabayashi
english_summary: Researchers found that blood serum from cats that recovered from a specific tick-borne fever can protect mice from the same virus, suggesting a potential future treatment for infected cats.
mandarin_summary: 研究发现，从特定蜱传热病中康复的猫的血清能保护小鼠免受该病毒侵害，这为未来治疗感染猫提供了潜在方向。
english_insight: This study is early research, so please talk to your vet if you are worried about tick-borne diseases and want to know the best ways to protect your cat.
mandarin_insight: 这是一项初步研究，如果您担心猫咪感染蜱虫传播的疾病，请咨询兽医以获取最有效的预防建议。

title: Free-Ranging Cat Predation on Wildlife in East Asia: A Scoping Review of Ecological Evidence and Knowledge Gaps.
authors: Michelle Zhibing Zhou; Christian S Wright
journal: Animals : an open access journal from MDPI
english_summary: This review found that free-ranging cats in East Asia prey on diverse wildlife, with the most significant conservation concerns identified in Japanese island ecosystems.
mandarin_summary: 这项研究发现东亚地区的散养猫会捕食多种野生动物，其中日本岛屿生态系统受到的影响最为显著。
english_insight: This study can help you understand that keeping your cat indoors helps protect local wildlife from being hunted.
mandarin_insight: 这项研究提醒您，将猫咪养在室内可以保护当地的野生动物免受捕食。

title: Age-Related Decrease in Interthalamic Adhesion Thickness in Cats Without Apparent Cognitive Dysfunction.
authors: Réjane Kerbrat-Copy; Océane Thérier; Marion Fusellier
journal: Animals : an open access journal from MDPI
english_summary: Researchers found that a specific part of the brain called the interthalamic adhesion naturally gets thinner as cats age, even in those without signs of cognitive decline.
mandarin_summary: 研究发现，即使猫咪没有认知功能障碍，大脑中一个叫间脑粘连的部位也会随着年龄增长而自然变薄。
english_insight: This study shows that brain changes in older cats are normal, so ask your vet if you notice any unusual behavior changes in your senior cat.
mandarin_insight: 这项研究表明老年猫的大脑变化是正常的，如果您发现猫咪行为有异常，请咨询您的兽医。

title: EXPRESS: Experimental Evaluation of the Immunogenicity of Feline Erythrocyte Antigen 6 (FEA 6) in Transfusion-Naive FEA 6-Negative Cats.
journal: Journal of feline medicine and surgery
english_summary: Researchers found that a newly identified blood antigen called FEA 6 is immunogenic, meaning it can trigger the production of antibodies in cats that receive a blood transfusion.
mandarin_summary: 研究发现猫的一种新血型抗原FEA 6具有免疫原性，输血可能引发受血猫产生抗体。
english_insight: This study helps vets understand why some cats have reactions to blood transfusions, so please ask your vet about blood typing if your cat ever needs a transfusion.
mandarin_insight: 这项研究帮助兽医了解猫输血反应的原因，如果您的猫需要输血，请务必咨询兽医进行血型匹配。

title: EXPRESS: Mineral Analysis of Feline Treats: Unrecognized Sources of Phosphorus and Calcium in the Management of Chronic Kidney Disease.
authors: Autumn Nourse Harris; Tonya Harris; Shelly Vaden
journal: Journal of feline medicine and surgery
english_summary: This study analyzed phosphorus and calcium levels in various cat treats and found that some popular purée treats contain high levels of phosphorus, which may impact cats with kidney disease.
mandarin_summary: 研究分析了猫零食中的磷和钙含量，发现某些猫用肉泥零食磷含量较高，可能影响患肾病猫的健康。
english_insight: If your cat has kidney disease, check with your vet about which treats are safe, as some snacks contain hidden minerals that could be harmful to their kidneys.
mandarin_insight: 如果您的猫患有肾病，请咨询兽医哪些零食可以吃，因为有些零食中含有的矿物质可能会加重肾脏负担。

title: EXPRESS: Assessment of an educational social media campaign on improving feline osteoarthritis pain awareness and knowledge among cat owners.
authors: Wing Sum Wong; Helena Alcântara; Syed S U H Bukhari; Jo Murrell; Paulo Steagall
journal: Journal of feline medicine and surgery
english_summary: An educational social media campaign successfully improved cat owners' understanding of osteoarthritis, including recognizing signs, risk factors, and the importance of environmental changes for affected cats.
mandarin_summary: 一项社交媒体教育活动有效提升了猫主人对猫关节炎的认知，包括识别症状、风险因素及环境改善的重要性。
english_insight: This study shows that learning about arthritis can help you spot early signs of pain in your cat, so talk to your vet about how to make your home more comfortable.
mandarin_insight: 这项研究表明，了解关节炎知识能帮您及早发现猫的疼痛迹象，请咨询兽医如何改善家居环境以减轻猫的痛苦。

title: Accounting for external events when analysing antimicrobial dispensing in the UK: An interrupted time series approach.
authors: S D Becker; D G O'Neill; S-M Frosini; L E Stapleton; D C Brodbelt
english_summary: This study analyzed how external events and regulations influence the rate at which veterinarians prescribe antibiotics to cats and dogs in the UK.
mandarin_summary: 这项研究分析了外部事件和法规如何影响英国兽医为猫狗开具抗生素的频率。
english_insight: This study helps researchers understand how to better track antibiotic use, but it does not change how you should care for your cat's health.
mandarin_insight: 这项研究帮助研究人员更好地追踪抗生素的使用，但它不会改变您照顾猫咪健康的方式。

title: Target-controlled infusion of propofol induces rapid hypertriglyceridemia in healthy cats.
authors: Francini Arboit; Luiza Tonietto Mangini; Jean Carlos Gasparotto; Leonardo Bergmann Griebeler; Júlia Odorissi Oliveira; Lisiane Saremba Vieira; Gabriel Satoru Ohashi; Vinícius da Silva Cadiñanos; Amanda Oliveira Paraguassú; Emilie Victória Oberbeck; Livia Benedeti de Souza; Gabrielle Coelho Freitas; Beatriz Perez Floriano; André Vasconcelos Soares
english_summary: Researchers found that using propofol for anesthesia in healthy cats causes a rapid and significant increase in blood triglyceride levels during the procedure.
mandarin_summary: 研究人员发现，健康猫咪在接受丙泊酚麻醉时，血液中的甘油三酯水平会迅速显著升高。
english_insight: This study shows that propofol can affect fat levels in your cat's blood during surgery, so ask your vet if this is a concern for your cat's specific health needs.
mandarin_insight: 这项研究表明丙泊酚可能会影响猫咪手术期间的血脂水平，如果您的猫咪有健康顾虑，请咨询兽医。
